summary: Two churches: St. Columba (Sat 5 PM, Sun 8 and 11 AM, weekday Masses Mon-Wed/Fri 6 PM and Thu 7:30 AM) and St. Augustine (Sun 9:30 AM), identical in both bulletins read. Confession is by appointment only. Open: whether the Neocatechumenal Way's Saturday 6 and 8 PM Eucharists are public Masses (leaning leave out). The website is an unreadable Wix page.
